services.name: Massage
services.desc: Couples Massage: Two Massage Therapists treat two people in the same studio. Single Massage: One Massage Therapist treats one person. Note: Prices do not include tax. Introducing our new CBD Infused Massage-our most popular offering! This massage includes fast-acting relief from our specially formulated CBD balm, rich in cannabidiol (CBD). With a clean, energizing scent, this all-natural, gluten-free balm enhances your experience and provides lasting relief for your muscles beyond the session. Enjoy the relaxation and comfort of this innovative approach to massage therapy! Please note: This balm affects the muscles and does not alter your mental state.
